name: Is It Love? Carter Corp. Gabriel
source:
You’re the heroine in this free Otome! You influence the story and the final conclusion!

You’ve just landed a job at Carter Corp., founded by the mysterious Ryan Carter. Your manager, Gabriel Simons, (besides being talented and seductive) has a reputation as a “serial lover”, making him the subject of many of your colleagues’ dreams. Covering his tracks, playing cat and mouse, sometimes a charmer and sometimes distant, you may risk falling into his claws...

[From Google Play Store]
translation:
你就是这个免费乙女中的女主角！你影响故事和最终结论！

你刚刚在卡特公司找到了一份工作，该公司由神秘的瑞安·卡特 (Ryan Carter) 创立。你的经理加布里埃尔·西蒙斯（Gabriel Simons）（除了才华横溢、魅力四射）还享有“连环情人”的美誉，这使他成为你许多同事梦寐以求的对象。掩盖他的踪迹，玩猫捉老鼠的游戏，时而迷人，时而疏远，你可能会陷入他的魔爪……

[来自Google Play商店]
